scope: Birth UI, birth options/name editing, shared character-sheet panels rendered during birth, sidebar/topbar/compact status and named data display endpoints. Source-reviewed migration proposal, not runtime catalog or complete Angband localization.
review_method: Read actual current C/gamedata; select visible presentation callsites, review semantic meaning and Japanese wording, retain canonical domain/parser identities, normalize named placeholders and preserve original C text separately. No global replacement, builds, browser activity or simulation changes.

coverage.ui_birth_text_literals: All visible text-bearing output literals in ui-birth.c reviewed, including conditional assembled prompts, error, skill/stat help, options actions, name/history and confirmation. Whitespace/control-only literals, command argument keys and parser identities excluded.

character_data.note: Race/class/title UI bindings reference these 110 independently owned endpoints; this manifest defines no competing translation entries. Birth book/spell descriptions are not shown in reviewed birth UI; character-data owns those separately.

integration_contract.ids: Human-reviewed semantic IDs; no hash IDs. Identity metadata binds unchanged domain keys/indices to display records; reuse duplicates only when meaning/behavior agrees.
integration_contract.parameters: EN/JA snake_case named-placeholder sets match declarations. original_english preserves printf/assembled English. original_call is the exact local C expression/table field or gamedata directive identified by source_kind. Separate presentation_call/presentation_call_source retain exact downstream C renderer calls for data/table records. Direct raw-string renderers use equivalent %s descriptive presentation notation, not a fabricated source literal.
integration_contract.names: Player/external usernames, frontend-provided character names and user-edited history remain verbatim. Resolve race/class/realm/ability/shape/grade/terrain display via semantic identities without altering canonical data.
integration_contract.rng: Formatting consumes captured identities/values only. Random names, rolls, traits and procedural history occur through existing commands; rendering never calls RNG or changes domain state.
integration_contract.cjk: Use grapheme-aware editing and measured terminal display cells. Replace strlen/sizeof byte strides, first-byte stat initials, fixed padding/ASCII columns, insufficient UTF8 buffers, English my_strcap and rest-string position patching. Actual input accelerators stay ASCII command metadata.

unresolved_grammars.issue: get_history joins RNG-selected ordered English fragments; stored history lacks locale-independent selected fragment/parameter records. User-edited history is preserved opaque, generated biography translation is not covered. Need capture chart/entry IDs at generation and locale-specific complete grammar without rerolling on render/load.
Components and whole learns template reviewed; ordered locale-aware list joining not integrated. English comma/and fragments cannot be globally replaced for Japanese.
Visible text reviewed; embedded colors are style spans rather than parameters. Structured rich text must preserve highlighted command keys.
Whole summary reviewed; independently colored danger/treasure token composition and original hidden/unknown branches require structured presentation integration.

exclusions: Full help manuals reached through ? and their navigation prompts; non-birth options pages. Help action label alone reviewed.

Gameplay message log, timed on-start/end/increase prose, object/monster names/plurals, targeting/examination prose, spell/ability browser descriptions, resistance/equipment character-sheet mode1 and dumps.

Pure numeric scalar formatting other than included compound/unit/stat-notation templates, health bars, equippy glyphs, natural maximum !, HP/SP slash, feeling ?/*/$ and whitespace clearing are presentation metadata rather than translated vocabulary.
Parser registration strings, command argument names, code/option/slot keys, canonical data comparisons, filenames and English comments are excluded from replacement.
Japanese wording is a reviewed proposal. Runtime text-ID integration, PC/mobile layout, IME/input, browser flows and save/resume remain untested here.
